title: The Sky-Piercer — Editor Intro
summary: Opening splash presents Sky-Piercer as accumulated practical knowledge rather than a pristine machine, while the unresolved detention and pursuit pressures force the vehicle to move.
panelPlan: Full-page opening/title splash with Sky-Piercer on its mobile cradle under hard Mojave light, still showing primer, mismatched finishes and visibly maintained field-built components. It should look formidable because it is coherent, not because it is sleek.
Use a few tactile close-detail insets integrated into the full-page composition—one tile, a farm-derived linkage, grounded telemetry hardware—without turning the page into a technical diagram.
Keep the road ahead open and uncertain. Rhonda's absence can be represented by an empty place or transferred key hardware, not by depicting any Issue 8 rescue event.

Do not show the sandstorm, maintenance closure, pursuit, launch confrontation, lockout order, kinetic authorization or Sky-Piercer in flight. The page ends with the vehicle ready to move, nothing more.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: That is because finished was never the requirement.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: One tile came from a school shop.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: A control linkage started life as farm hardware.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: The telemetry harness carries a lesson learned beside a noisy pump.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: Every scar on the vehicle is a problem somebody solved well enough to move on.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: Now the largest thing Launch-Shop has ever built is sitting on a mobile cradle in the Mojave.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: Tethergrid is still looking for a center it can shut down.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: And the rocket is ready to move.

directionInline.text: Non-diegetic opening title page. Preserve exact caption text. The page may synthesize established lessons from prior issues and the ending state of Issue 7, but it must not reveal any new Issue 8 action or outcome. Make Sky-Piercer spectacular through physical specificity and accumulated history.
